title: Psychophysical bases of perceived exertion
takes: A 0-10 category-ratio scale of perceived exertion: one number for how draining something was. The ledger's load.

title: Toyota Production System: Beyond Large-Scale Production
takes: Jidoka, automation with a human touch: the machine judges and stops itself on anything abnormal, so no person stands by to judge. Why tests must judge sound and pictures themselves.

title: Development of NASA-TLX (Task Load Index)
by: Sandra G. Hart, Lowell E. Staveland
takes: Workload in six parts - mental, physical and time demand, performance, effort, frustration. Too heavy for every bump; kept in mind for a richer load later.

title: Eliminating Toil (Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 5)
by: Vivek Rau; ed. Beyer, Jones, Petoff, Murphy
takes: Toil: manual, repetitive, automatable, tactical, without enduring value, growing with scale - counted and kept within a budget. The ledger counts exactly this.

title: Is It Worth the Time?
takes: How much time an automation may cost before it pays: time per occurrence times frequency over a horizon.
